name: MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap
type: {α β E : Type*} → [MeasurableSpace α] → [MeasurableSpace β] → {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} → {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure β} → [NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ] → [MeasureTheory.SFinite ν] → {f : α → β → E} → MeasureTheory.Integrable (Function.uncurry f) (μ.prod ν) → (∫ x, ∫ y, f x y ∂ν ∂μ) = ∫ y, ∫ x, f x y ∂μ ∂ν
provides: Fubini interchange of two Bochner integrals under product integrability and s-finiteness of both measures.
